purpose: Human overview of the entire source; exact frame mappings are in part-*.json and vectors/part-*.zip.
intervals_are: Approximate narrative ranges, not asserted exact cut timestamps.

sequences.action: Orange stick character approaches the waterslide; gray visitors, tables, shower, and slide entrance establish the setting.
Character moves through the dark blue slide with splashes and rapid pose changes; transition to the dry landscape.
Orange character traverses the landscape and approaches a yellow water container on a metal stand.
Cup/tap interaction and drinking-related gestures; container and lid are handled while a gray resident appears.
Residents carry water and work around homes and excavations; camera reveals local conditions.
Orange character gestures with a resident and leans over/into the container; pose and framing change.
Blue character joins Orange; exchange of objects, gestures, and helmets introduces the construction plan.
Diagram on the container and helmeted characters link the plan to a larger village view.
A vehicle and workers arrive; equipment and a water tower become visible among the residents.
Orange celebrates; camera expands to a broad view of settlements and distribution across the landscape.
Return to the park; Orange presents a population/percentage graphic, including a red highlighted group.
Board drawings show water-related actions, donations appear, and the displayed percentage changes.
The percentage board moves aside and the campaign message appears while characters react.
Board displays teamwater.org, the funding goal, and the August date range with a stopwatch graphic.
LINK BELOW and a downward arrow accompany character gestures and falling donations.
Final park action and the source ending, retained with the complete original audio duration.

limitations: This overview is not a joint-by-joint motion annotation. Frame-aligned SVGs provide the visible shape trajectories; optical flow and affine camera candidates are estimates. No movement is invented between original frames.
